jobs.title: Azure Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to take ownership of Azure infrastructure in a truly international environment?

At Manuchar
, technology connects teams and operations across the globe. As our Azure Cloud Engineer
, based in Bonifacio Global City, you’ll help keep that environment secure, reliable and ready to grow.

This is a senior, hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys solving complex infrastructure challenges while also looking at the bigger picture. You’ll work across identity, cloud infrastructure, Azure Virtual Desktop, databases, security and cost optimisation — with the opportunity to improve, automate and shape the way we manage our Azure environment.

You’ll be part of an international IT organisation and collaborate with application teams, data engineers, security stakeholders and colleagues across different regions.

What will you do?

Azure infrastructure & automation

Design, deploy and maintain secure and scalable Azure infrastructure.
Build and maintain Bicep templates for repeatable, policy-compliant deployments.
Develop CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions.
Maintain Azure Policy, tagging strategies and naming conventions across subscriptions.

Identity & access management

Manage Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, PIM, MFA and RBAC.
Govern user provisioning, groups and role assignments.
Support hybrid identity between on-premises Active Directory and Entra ID.

Azure Virtual Desktop

Deploy and manage AVD host pools, session hosts, application groups and workspaces.
Improve image management and update cycles.
Troubleshoot connectivity, FSLogix and performance issues.

Database & cloud workloads

Manage Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Database for PostgreSQL/MySQL and SQL Server on Azure VMs.
Implement and test backup, restore and high-availability strategies.
Collaborate with our data teams on Microsoft Fabric integration and connectivity.

Security, reliability & FinOps

Apply security best practices using Microsoft Defender for Cloud and relevant Azure/CIS benchmarks.
Manage patching, vulnerability scanning, endpoint protection and business continuity.
Monitor Azure consumption and identify opportunities to optimise cloud costs.
Support budgets, alerts, rightsizing, reserved instances and FinOps reporting.
Maintain monitoring, alerting and operational runbooks.

You’ll also act as an escalation point for cloud-related incidents and contribute to architecture decisions, documentation and continuous improvement across our cloud environment.

What do you bring?

5+ years of hands-on cloud infrastructure experience, with a strong focus on Microsoft Azure.
Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID, including Conditional Access, PIM and hybrid identity.
Production experience with Azure Virtual Desktop.
Strong experience with Bicep/ARM and Infrastructure as Code.
Practical experience with Azure cost management and FinOps.
Working knowledge of Azure database services and backup strategies.
Good understanding of Azure networking, including VNets, NSGs and private endpoints.
Experience working in hybrid Azure/on-premises environments.
A strong security mindset and experience with Microsoft Defender for Cloud and RBAC.
Familiarity with Microsoft Fabric is an asset.
You communicate easily with technical colleagues, business stakeholders and external vendors.
You’re comfortable collaborating remotely with colleagues across different countries and time zones.

Certifications

Relevant Microsoft certifications are an asset, including:

AZ-104

AZ-305
AZ-500
SC-300
AZ-800/801
AZ-900

What can you expect from Manuchar?

A senior engineering role with real ownership of an international Azure environment.
A broad technical scope with plenty of variety and challenging cloud projects.
The opportunity to bring your own ideas and help us automate, standardise and continuously improve our infrastructure.
Collaboration with IT and business teams across our global organisation.
Support for professional development and relevant certifications.
A competitive salary and benefits package.

Interested?

We’d be happy to hear from you. Send your profile to ph.hrad@manuchar.com
.

About Manuchar

Manuchar is a leading distributor of chemicals across high-growth markets and actively trades several other commodities. Headquartered in Antwerp, Belgium, we combine our international reach with strong local presence and expertise.

With operations across more than 180 locations worldwide, our teams provide end-to-end commercial, supply chain and financing solutions to customers around the globe.

Our mission: “Connecting the World. For Better Lives.”
